notes: Audited against Engrossed-in-House (EH) source text. Two independent material errors: (1) update/publication frequency stated as 'quarterly' in brief and gaps[0] but the source says 'and annually thereafter' (analysis's own summary/top_lines/sections/changes correctly say annually); (2) the underreported field claims the requirement covers 'any offense' with 'no category restriction', flatly contradicting the source's 'covered offense' limitation (and the analysis's own Section 2 detail) — this describes the superseded Introduced text, per the cache's versionChanges. Also flagged the fabricated '80+ Democrats' crossover figure in likelihoodReason (no party breakdown in source or votes[]). No material omissions: short title, publication requirement, deadline/cadence, and the full covered-offense definition are all covered.
